scanner_doubts: Not a miscount, a rule-scope question: all 6 qe-fig-007 hits in eigen_I.md (138, 221, 247, 539, 616, 746) are `spines[spine].set_color('none')` on 'right'/'top', each paired with a `set_position('zero')` two lines earlier (135-138, 218-221, 244-247, 536-539, 613-616, 743-746). That pair is the standard idiom for drawing axes through the origin, which these vector diagrams need. Complying with qe-fig-007 as written would mean giving up the origin-crossing axes. The same idiom appears in linear_equations.md and scalar_dynam.md in this series (grep `set_position('zero')`), so it is worth deciding once whether the rule is meant to fire on it - as distinct from a plain `spines['top'].set_visible(False)` despine, which it should.
